    changes=[

        ("default=HERE/'generated/BisimRouting245Pilot.lean'","default=REPO/'Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/BisimRouting245Pilot.lean'"),
        ("default=HERE/'generated/Audit.lean'","default=HERE/'bisim_routing245_pilot_audit.lean'"),
        ("default=HERE/'prepare_pilot.py'","default=HERE/'bisim-routing245-pilot/provenance/prepare_pilot.py'"),
        ("default=HERE/'generated/source-inventory.json'","default=HERE/'bisim-routing245-pilot/source-inventory.json'"),
        ("default=HERE/'dependency-boundary-plan.json'","default=HERE/'bisim-routing245-pilot/dependency-boundary-plan.json'"),

        ("program_parent=a.program_parent.resolve())","program_parent=(a.program_parent or repo/'Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/program-routing245-verification.json').resolve())"),
        ("repo/'SetTheory/Cardinals/docs/reports/set-theory/zfc-closure-kernels/data/68-route245-certificate-register_bisimulation.json'","repo/'Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/bisim-routing245-pilot/register-bisimulation.json'"),

        raw=p.read_bytes();h=sha(p);hf.append(dict(relative_path=name,original_path=str(p),sha256=h,bytes=len(raw)))
        blobs.setdefault(h,dict(bytes=len(raw),utf8=raw.decode('utf-8')))
    for row in hf:
        raw=blobs[row['sha256']]['utf8'].encode('utf-8');need(len(raw)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],'History roundtrip differs.')
    history=out/'bisim-routing245-pilot-history.json'

Compiled providers remain historical cached objects, explicitly identified below.',

    files.append(dict(source=str(history),destination=str(HOST/'results'/history.name),sha256=sha(history)))
    metadata=out/'bisim-routing245-pilot-publication.json'

        original_executed_guard=desc(executed),portable_guard=desc(guard),guard_default_substitutions=changes,

        theorem_scope='Initial segment plus entries0,90,103,329,791,3012 only; full3013data included, allC and halting equivalence remain open.',
        source_and_audit_from_actual_pass=True,maintained_note_owned_by_root=True,
        compiled_artifacts_scope='Cached .olean files are identified by paths/hashes; no clean-checkout dependency reconstruction claimed.',
        files=files,maintained_default_preparation='Pending root installation and separate no-proof preparation.',
        packet_author_guard_or_compiler_execution=False,maintained_edits=False),indent=2)+'\n')
    files.append(dict(source=str(metadata),destination=str(HOST/'results'/metadata.name),sha256=sha(metadata)))
    mapping=out/'map.json';mapping.write_text(json.dumps(dict(files=files,scope='Eleven-file completed pilot packet; root owns scoped note and separate maintained-default evidence.'),indent=2)+'\n')
    print(mapping,sha(mapping),len(files));print('history',len(hf),'paths',len(blobs),'unique UTF-8 blobs')
